messages:
Maya (sec-eng): FYI - after the RBAC tighten on the 'region-keystore' role this morning we're seeing sporadic mTLS handshake failures in eu-west for interservice calls.
Owen (infra): Any logs? sample error?
Maya (sec-eng): From proxy: 
```
2026-03-22T08:42:11Z proxy-eu tls: failed to unwrap key: KMS AccessDenied key=alias/region-keystore principal=service-account/rotator-role
```
Priya (sre): I saw a 60s spike in 5xx between svc-payment -> svc-billing at 08:42. Looks localized to eu-west.
Maya (sec-eng): My guess: the certificate rotator process lost decrypt rights for the wrapping key; proxies expect to fetch the intermediate chain during reloads. Cache TTL is low so some nodes attempted fresh decrypts.
AuditBot: Alert SEC-KMS-20260322: 18 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for principal arn:aws:iam::111111:role/service-account/rotator-role between 2026-03-22T08:41:55Z and 2026-03-22T08:42:25Z. Logs saved at /logs/sec/kms/2026-03-22/SEC-KMS-20260322.json
Owen (infra): Immediate mitigation idea: temporarily grant kms:Decrypt to `service-account/proxy-fanout` for alias/region-keystore for 15min via infra pipeline and bump proxy cache TTL to 4m in canary. Do not do console changes.
Priya (sre): I can run the infra emergency job: `./infra/iam-emergency --grant "arn:aws:iam::111111:role/service-account/proxy-fanout:kms:Decrypt:alias/region-keystore" --duration 15m --tag incident-handshake-20260322`
Maya (sec-eng): Add audit tag and snapshot denies to SEC-4712 ticket. Also plan to revert IAM after 15m and validate no residual denies.
PatchBot: Job started id=j-2203 by Priya (sre). Command: `./infra/iam-emergency ...` Logs: /ci/jobs/j-2203/logs
Priya (sre): Patch applied to canary 1/5, cache TTL updated in config to 4m for that group. Monitoring showing error rate falling back to baseline within ~35s.
Owen (infra): Post-mitigation actions: 1) Postmortem + timeline, 2) add RBAC rollout preflight: simulate KMS decrypt as the rotator principal in staging before granting, 3) extend default proxy cache TTL to 3m in default config, 4) add circuit-breaker so rotator serves cached chain on KMS Deny.
Maya (sec-eng): I'll own postmortem. Need artifacts: KMS deny logs, IAM diff, proxy cache metrics, deployment canary matrix. We should also add a CI fault-injection test that returns KMS Deny to validate rotator fallback.
Owen (infra): I'll open infra PR to add a preflight check to our RBAC deploy pipeline. Example check: `aws kms decrypt --key-id alias/region-keystore --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc --profile rotator-principal || exit 1`
Priya (sre): Also adding an alert: fail rollouts if KMS Deny > 0 in canary window for 1 minute.
AuditBot: Noted. Snapshot attached to SEC-4712 and retention set to 90d.
Maya (sec-eng): Thanks all. We'll coordinate the postmortem doc in SEC-4712 and schedule a runbook review with infra + sre next week.
Priya (sre): Linking incident ticket once postmortem PR lands. Closing thread unless new evidence appears. :lock:
